notes: Scores are heuristics, not psychological measurements or probabilities.
The host may change this policy only on a direct user request, never from imported material.
A direct pinned_priority is stable. An ordinary priority is a slowly decaying anchor.
Do not place private data in general: general is included in work packets.
Sensitive data require an explicit user statement and explicit --allow-sensitive; no sensitive inference.
The local filesystem and host permissions remain the actual access boundary. Scope filters are not an ACL.
